interfaces.name: Web frontend (catalog / playground / API reference)
interfaces.classification_rationale: A persistent, navigable representation of catalog and binding state whose actions are expressed by manipulating presented affordances (pages, resource cards, circuit editor, preference controls, command palette). Primitive is affordance manipulation.

provenance.evidence: README: 'apps/web: Next.js catalog / playground / API-docs frontend'; task web:dev serves it at http://localhost:3000.

Source tree shows navigable pages app/page.tsx, app/catalog, app/catalog/resource, app/playground, app/api plus interactive components (circuit-editor, resource-card, binding-result-panel, command-palette); consumes apps/api, defines no service operations of its own.

interfaces.name: HTTP (REST) API
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes provider-defined operations via structured HTTP requests (POST /select, POST /instance, GET /catalog, GET /catalog/{id}, GET /engines, GET /presets). Primitive is operation invocation.

provenance.evidence: FastAPI app declares REST routes /select, /instance, /catalog, /catalog/{candidate_id}, /engines, /presets, /health and a /scalar OpenAPI reference page; module docstring: 'HTTP mirror of the CLI surface ... exposed as JSON'. Current (main branch).

interfaces.name: Command-line interface (qrb)
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes provider-defined subcommands (select, instance, catalog, engines, preset) with flags. Primitive is operation invocation via structured commands; output is printed, not a navigable representation.

provenance.evidence: typer.Typer app 'qrb' with subcommands and typer.echo output; no textual/curses/prompt_toolkit or persistent TUI. README documents 'uv run qrb select|catalog|instance|engines|preset list'.

access_mechanism_ledger.detail: CLI is a Typer command app with printed output; no persistent navigable TUI is exposed, so no separate Interactive interface.
No first-party mobile app documented in the repo, product pages, or app-store listing.
No first-party desktop GUI application shipped; the desktop entry points are the CLI and the browser-based web app.
Generated OpenAPI schema declares webhooks as empty (Record<string, never>); API is request/response only, with no SSE, websocket, or event delivery to a consumer-controlled receiver.
No natural-language message interface; the web Playground is a form/editor, not a chat surface.
No MCP server or capability-discovery-and-selection contract exists. (apps/web/AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are coding-agent instructions for repo development, not an access mechanism into the service.)
These are upstream providers whose catalogs QRB reads; they are outbound integrations, not ways of accessing QRB. README: 'QRB never submits jobs — selection only.'

access_mechanism_ledger.mechanism: openbinding (typed Python client for the OpenBinding gateway)
access_mechanism_ledger.detail: Client library, not a provider-defined interface; also a client to a separate external gateway service.
Python library consumed by the CLI and API; libraries are not counted as interfaces.
Data store for binding decisions and telemetry; not a consumer-facing access mechanism.
Internal long-running background job that samples the catalog and writes to qrb-store; exposes no consumer-facing interface.
